ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Colony Visibility
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The Colony Visibility dial (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/colony_visibility_stat.md, F18/F12): a shared 0-100 GameComponent stat, read by a five-band ladder (Hidden/Discreet/Noticed/Marked/Exposed), that multiplies hostile threat-point sizing instead of stacking on top of vanilla's wealth scaling.
Rehomed and rebuilt from COLONY_VISIBILITY_STAT_1's earlier work (which lived inside mandrake.rut.doctrine) into its own dedicated mod per this item's own naming - the mechanism is engine-generic; Ash'karr-specific triggers (Ishko/Sh'kaar/Ta'Baa/Ozzik) are a separate RUT-tier content pack's job, calling into this mod's Adjust().
Ta'Baa's launch reset (a real Harmony postfix on GravshipUtility.GenerateGravship) is wired. The threat-point multiplier targets hostile-only call sites per the owner's 2026-08-31 ruling closing the global-vs-threat-scoped fork.
